name: Promises with passing checks
what: Silo promises in public only the properties whose checks pass on the version it describes, and a promise whose check fails comes off until it passes again. Each result says what was checked and how, such as "checked on every sequence of up to N calls", and what the check does not look at. It never says "proven".

suggest.why: People who give agents full access want to see what was checked, and the page is written by the checks themselves.
